def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(H):

            if g[r][c]==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            col=g[r][c]; q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); pts=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.pop(); pts.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and (ny,nx) not in seen and g[ny][nx]==col:
                        seen.add((ny,nx));q.append((ny,nx))
            comps.append((col,pts))
    marker=None
    for col,pts in comps:
        rs=[r for r,c in pts]; cs=[c for r,c in pts]
        r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs);c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
        S=set(pts)
        # L-shaped component joining two adjacent canvas edges.

    _,y,x,target_color=min(candidates)
    # recolor the entire 4-connected component of the encountered object

def transform_vertical_pattern(grid, verbose=False):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid];h,w=len(out),len(out[0]);bg=Counter(v for row in out for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps=comps4(out,bg);guide=None
    for col,cells in comps:
      S=set(cells);rs=[r for r,c in cells];cs=[c for r,c in cells];r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
      if r0==0 and c0==0 and (r1,c1) in S and all(r==r1 or c==c1 for r,c in cells):guide=(col,cells,(0,r1,0,c1),'top');break
      if r1==h-1 and c1==w-1 and (r0,c0) in S and all(r==r0 or c==c0 for r,c in cells):guide=(col,cells,(r0,h-1,c0,w-1),'bottom');break
      if r0==0 and c1==w-1 and (r1,c0) in S and all(r==r1 or c==c0 for r,c in cells):guide=(col,cells,(0,r1,c0,w-1),'top');break
      if r1==h-1 and c0==0 and (r0,c1) in S and all(r==r0 or c==c1 for r,c in cells):guide=(col,cells,(r0,h-1,0,c1),'bottom');break
    if guide is None:return out,[]
    gc,gcells,(rmin,rmax,cmin,cmax),side=guide;gs=set(gcells)
    framed=[(cl,ps) for cl,ps in comps if cl!=gc and all(rmin<=r<=rmax and cmin<=c<=cmax for r,c in ps)]
    if not framed:return out,[]
    tc,tp=min(framed,key=lambda x:(len(x[1]),min(x[1])))
    rb=min(r for r,c in tp);cb=min(c for r,c in tp);shape={(r-rb,c-cb) for r,c in tp};tset=set(tp)
    maxdr=max(r for r,c in shape);maxdc=max(c for r,c in shape)
    occurrences=[]
    for rr in range(h-maxdr):
      for cc in range(w-maxdc):
        cells={(rr+dr,cc+dc) for dr,dc in shape}
        if cells==tset or cells & gs or cells & tset:continue
        rows=[r for r,c in cells];cols=[c for r,c in cells]
        outside=min(rows)>rmax if side=='top' else max(rows)<rmin
        if not outside:continue
        vals={out[r][c] for r,c in cells}
        if len(vals)!=1:continue
        col=next(iter(vals))
        if col==bg or col==gc:continue
        # Singleton templates must match a whole singleton object, not an arbitrary pixel.
        if len(tp)==1 and not any(cl==col and set(ps)==cells for cl,ps in comps):continue
        dist=((rb-rr)**2+(cb-cc)**2)**0.5
        occurrences.append((col,cells,dist,(rr,cc)))
    dif=[o for o in occurrences if o[0]!=tc]
    cand=dif if dif else occurrences
    if cand:

      for col,cells,dist,pos in chosen:
       for r,c in cells:out[r][c]=gc
    if verbose:return out,[(o[0],o[2],o[3],len(o[1])) for o in sorted(occurrences,key=lambda x:x[2])]
    return out,[]
